title: TPI — Análisis Académico TUP | Bontorno, Mas, Vernier, Mejias, Hassan, Nuñez

list.name: Turno
list.label: Turno
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT Turno FROM alumnos ORDER BY Turno

list.name: Comision
list.label: Comisión
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT Comision FROM alumnos ORDER BY Comision

panels.title: Tasa de Presentación al Parcial
panels.description: % de alumnos que se presentaron al parcial (Estado ≠ Ausente). Responde a los filtros de Turno y Comisión.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Estado_Final != 'Ausente' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "Tasa" FROM alumnos WHERE Turno IN (${Turno:singlequote}) AND Comision IN (${Comision:singlequote})
targets.queryText: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Estado_Final != 'Ausente' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "Tasa" FROM alumnos WHERE Turno IN (${Turno:singlequote}) AND Comision IN (${Comision:singlequote})

panels.title: Alumnos Aprobados
panels.description: Total de alumnos con estado final Aprobado (nota parcial ≥ 6). Responde a los filtros.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Aprobados" FROM alumnos WHERE Estado_Final = 'Aprobado' AND Turno IN (${Turno:singlequote}) AND Comision IN (${Comision:singlequote})
targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Aprobados" FROM alumnos WHERE Estado_Final = 'Aprobado' AND Turno IN (${Turno:singlequote}) AND Comision IN (${Comision:singlequote})

panels.title: Alumnos en Riesgo (Constancia < 43%)
panels.description: Alumnos cuyo Índice de Constancia está por debajo del umbral de alerta temprana de abandono (43%).

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "En Riesgo" FROM alumnos WHERE Indice_Constancia < 43 AND Turno IN (${Turno:singlequote}) AND Comision IN (${Comision:singlequote})
targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "En Riesgo" FROM alumnos WHERE Indice_Constancia < 43 AND Turno IN (${Turno:singlequote}) AND Comision IN (${Comision:singlequote})

panels.title: Total Alumnos (filtrados)
panels.description: Cantidad de alumnos que cumplen los filtros activos. Base total: 700.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Total" FROM alumnos WHERE Turno IN (${Turno:singlequote}) AND Comision IN (${Comision:singlequote})
targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Total" FROM alumnos WHERE Turno IN (${Turno:singlequote}) AND Comision IN (${Comision:singlequote})

panels.title: Distribución de Estados Finales
panels.description: Aprobado / Recupera / Desaprobado / Ausente. Responde a los filtros de Turno y Comisión.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT Estado_Final AS "Estado", COUNT(*) AS "Cantidad" FROM alumnos WHERE Turno IN (${Turno:singlequote}) AND Comision IN (${Comision:singlequote}) GROUP BY Estado_Final ORDER BY Cantidad DESC
targets.queryText: SELECT Estado_Final AS "Estado", COUNT(*) AS "Cantidad" FROM alumnos WHERE Turno IN (${Turno:singlequote}) AND Comision IN (${Comision:singlequote}) GROUP BY Estado_Final ORDER BY Cantidad DESC

panels.title: Nota Promedio del Parcial por Comisión
panels.description: Comparativa entre comisiones. Umbral de aprobación = 6. Responde a los filtros.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT Comision AS "Comisión", ROUND(AVG(Nota_Parcial), 2) AS "Nota Promedio" FROM alumnos WHERE Nota_Parcial IS NOT NULL AND Turno IN (${Turno:singlequote}) AND Comision IN (${Comision:singlequote}) GROUP BY Comision ORDER BY Comision
targets.queryText: SELECT Comision AS "Comisión", ROUND(AVG(Nota_Parcial), 2) AS "Nota Promedio" FROM alumnos WHERE Nota_Parcial IS NOT NULL AND Turno IN (${Turno:singlequote}) AND Comision IN (${Comision:singlequote}) GROUP BY Comision ORDER BY Comision

panels.title: Índice de Constancia Promedio — Ausentes vs Presentes
panels.description: La brecha confirma que la baja constancia predice el abandono. Responde a los filtros.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE WHEN Estado_Final = 'Ausente' THEN 'Ausente' ELSE 'Presente' END AS "Grupo", ROUND(AVG(Indice_Constancia), 1) AS "Índice de Constancia" FROM alumnos WHERE Turno IN (${Turno:singlequote}) AND Comision IN (${Comision:singlequote}) GROUP BY Grupo ORDER BY Grupo
targets.queryText: SELECT CASE WHEN Estado_Final = 'Ausente' THEN 'Ausente' ELSE 'Presente' END AS "Grupo", ROUND(AVG(Indice_Constancia), 1) AS "Índice de Constancia" FROM alumnos WHERE Turno IN (${Turno:singlequote}) AND Comision IN (${Comision:singlequote}) GROUP BY Grupo ORDER BY Grupo

panels.title: Evolución de Nota Promedio y Tasa de Entrega por Actividad
panels.description: La tasa de entrega cae del 87% al 60% mientras la nota se mantiene estable: el problema es abandono, no rendimiento.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT Actividad, ROUND(AVG(Nota), 2) AS "Nota Promedio", ROUND(100.0 * AVG(Hizo_Entrega), 1) AS "Tasa de Entrega (%)" FROM entregas GROUP BY Actividad ORDER BY MIN(Fecha_Limite)
targets.queryText: SELECT Actividad, ROUND(AVG(Nota), 2) AS "Nota Promedio", ROUND(100.0 * AVG(Hizo_Entrega), 1) AS "Tasa de Entrega (%)" FROM entregas GROUP BY Actividad ORDER BY MIN(Fecha_Limite)
